args.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I like how clean and simple your site is — it's easy to navigate and gets straight to the point. One suggestion: it might be nice to add a bit more content about yourself, such as your interests, background, or projects you're working on, so visitors can get to know you better. Also, having a contact form or a bit more context around your email could make it easier for people to reach out. Overall, a great start — keep it up!

Hi Eve! I just visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that you share your passion for hiking — it gives your blog a personal and authentic touch! A few suggestions: it would be great to see more content, like posts about your favorite hiking trails, tips for beginners, or photos from your adventures. Adding categories or tags could also help readers find topics they're interested in. Overall, I enjoyed the personal feel of your blog and look forward to reading more about your hiking experiences!
